failure_signature: Leakage or aggregate score hides failure.
control: Use ROUTE_SELECTOR_MIN or FULL and name the unit, evidence and prohibited inference.

failure_signature: Access, permission, evidence, time or evaluation burden remains assumed rather than tested.
control: Run the smallest safe feasibility sprint and record continue, narrow, pivot or stop.

failure_signature: A leaderboard score, benchmark popularity or model-card summary substitutes for source-level and data-level evidence.
control: Verify dataset provenance, unit of independence, split logic, leakage controls, baselines, calibration, error analysis and relevant state-of-the-art comparisons.

failure_signature: Prediction does not establish explanation, causality or organisational impact.
control: Data audit, leakage test, baseline run and pipeline rehearsal.; preserve work-unit provenance and deviations.

failure_signature: Best metric becomes universal superiority, fairness or deployment value
control: Source-grouped or temporal split, leakage audit, ordinary seeds and subgroup review; retain counter-evidence and rejected stronger wording.

failure_signature: The thesis, evidence package, demonstration, slides or oral account describes a different route, release, result or claim.
control: Load the frozen held-out set, compare the keyword and linear baselines, inspect calibration and retrieve three adverse errors without live retraining. Preserve a same-release fallback and rehearse the hostile question.
